summary: This Form 8-K filed by BillionToOne, Inc. reports the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on June 10, 2026. Stockholders voted on two proposals: the election of two Class I directors and the ratification of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor. The filing provides vote tallies but no material definitive agreement, financial obligation, or special-situation event. The registrant is the filer reporting routine governance matters. As a standard shareholder meeting disclosure without any transformative corporate action, it does not qualify as a special situation.
